rootCause.summary: CallerRetainsStreamOwnership requires a 2-byte write on a fresh DriverEvidence sink to succeed and requires CanWriteCalls to stay 0. ProbeStream.CanWrite throws, and ProbeStream.Write called MemoryStream.Write. On Framework mscorlib, MemoryStream.Write calls EnsureWriteable, which callvirts Stream.get_CanWrite. That throw is caught by CaseBudgetV3.TryWrite, which holds and returns false. Check then throws InvalidOperationException with label ownership-write. The module must accept this write when Stream.Write returns. The fixture made Write throw. The success assertion stays; the fixture no longer delegates Write or WriteByte to MemoryStream.
